image_description: A dynamic action shot from an ice hockey game featuring three players on the ice. The central figure is a player in a white jersey with red and black trim, labeled 'OMAHA' with the number 9, skating forward while handling a puck with his stick. To the left, a goalie in orange and white gear is in a defensive stance. To the right, an opposing player in a red jersey (number 41) is skating alongside. The background shows the rink boards with advertisements.
